title: Seoul T-Money Card: Buy, Top Up and Use It
summary: Learn where to buy a T-money card in Seoul, how to top it up with cash, and when to tap on and off for subway and bus rides.

slides.title: Skip Seoul Ticket Machines
slides.voice: Seoul transit: skip ticket machines. Get T-money.

slides.title: Find One Nearby
slides.voice: Buy one at CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, or an Incheon Airport convenience store.

slides.title: Bring Cash
slides.voice: Top up with cash; the card starts empty. Twenty to thirty thousand won is a sensible first load.
slides.photo_query: T-money card recharge machine cash Seoul

slides.title: Tap Both Ways
slides.sub: Tap in and out at subway gates
slides.voice: Tap at the subway gate entering and leaving; your exit tap matters.

slides.title: Tap Off, Too
slides.sub: Tap on and off; use the same card
slides.voice: On buses, tap by the driver, then by the rear door. Tap off to keep transfer discounts.
